# hpe_morpheus_plugin (Data Source)



The `hpe_morpheus_plugin` data source provides details about an existing Morpheus
plugin, looked up by either its Morpheus `id` or its unique `code` (for example
`morpheus-infoblox-plugin`). Exactly one of `id` or `code` must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_plugin" "by_code" {
  code = "morpheus-infoblox-plugin"
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_plugin" "by_id" {
  id = 99
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `code` (String) Unique code of the plugin (as reported by the plugin, for example `morpheus-infoblox-plugin`).
- `id` (Number) Morpheus ID of the plugin

### Read-Only

- `author` (String) The author reported by the plugin.
- `config` (Dynamic) Plugin configuration values keyed by the plugin's option type field names.
- `date_created` (String) The date and time the plugin was installed.
- `description` (String) The description reported by the plugin.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the plugin is enabled.
- `has_valid_update` (Boolean) Whether a newer compatible version was found on the plugin exchange by the last update check.
- `is_prepackaged` (Boolean) Indicates whether the plugin is prepackaged and bundled with the appliance.
- `issue_tracker_url` (String) The URL of the plugin's issue tracker.
- `last_updated` (String) The date and time the plugin was last updated.
- `name` (String) The display name reported by the plugin.
- `providers` (Attributes List) The capabilities (providers) contributed by the plugin. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))
- `source_code_location_url` (String) The URL of the plugin's source code.
- `status` (String) The lifecycle status of the plugin, one of `installing`, `updating`, `loaded` or `error`.
- `status_message` (String) Details of the last load failure when the status is `error`.
- `valid` (Boolean) Whether the plugin descriptor was valid and the plugin class could be loaded.
- `version` (String) The version of the installed plugin jar.
- `website_url` (String) The plugin's website URL.

<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The display name of the provider.
- `type` (String) The provider type, for example `Cloud`, `IPAM` or `Task`.
